passages.text: Then the whole congregation of Israel assembled at Shiloh and set up the Tent of Meeting there. And though the land was subdued before them, there were still seven tribes of Israel who had not yet received their inheritance.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were God's chosen people.
All the people of Israel gathered together at Shiloh.
They set up the Tent of Meeting at Shiloh.
The Tent of Meeting was the special place where they worshiped God.
The Israelites had conquered the land in front of them.
The land was now under their control.
But seven tribes of Israel had not yet received their share of the land.
These seven tribes had not divided their inheritance.
passages.original: וַיִּקָּ֨הֲל֜וּ כָּל־ עֲדַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ שִׁלֹ֔ה וַיַּשְׁכִּ֥ינוּ שָׁ֖ם אֶת־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְהָאָ֥רֶץ נִכְבְּשָׁ֖ה לִפְנֵיהֶֽם׃ וַיִּוָּֽתְרוּ֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ חָלְק֖וּ אֶת־ נַֽחֲלָתָ֑ם שִׁבְעָ֖ה שְׁבָטִֽים׃

passages.text: So Joshua said to the Israelites, “How long will you put off entering and possessing the land that the LORD, the God of your fathers, has given you?
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel after Moses.
Joshua spoke to the Israelites.
Joshua said, “How long will you wait?
Why do you delay to enter the land?
The LORD is your God.
The LORD is the God of your fathers.
The LORD has given you this land.
Why do you not go and take possession of it?”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל עַד־ אָ֙נָה֙ אַתֶּ֣ם מִתְרַפִּ֔ים לָבוֹא֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן לָכֶ֔ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Appoint three men from each tribe, and I will send them out to survey the land and map it out, according to the inheritance of each. Then they will return to me and divide the land into seven portions. Judah shall remain in their territory in the south, and the house of Joseph shall remain in their territory in the north.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel at this time.
Joshua spoke to the Israelites.
He told them to choose three men from each tribe.
Joshua said he would send these men out.
The men would walk through the land.
They would map the land.
They would record the land according to each tribe’s inheritance.
The men would return to Joshua.
They would divide the land into seven portions.
Judah would stay in its territory in the south.
The house of Joseph would stay in its territory in the north.
passages.original: הָב֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה אֲנָשִׁ֖ים לַשָּׁ֑בֶט וְאֶשְׁלָחֵ֗ם וְיָקֻ֜מוּ וְיִֽתְהַלְּכ֥וּ בָאָ֛רֶץ וְיִכְתְּב֥וּ אוֹתָ֛הּ לְפִ֥י נַֽחֲלָתָ֖ם וְיָבֹ֥אוּ אֵלָֽי׃ וְהִֽתְחַלְּק֥וּ אֹתָ֖הּ לְשִׁבְעָ֣ה חֲלָקִ֑ים יְהוּדָ֞ה יַעֲמֹ֤ד עַל־ גְּבוּלוֹ֙ מִנֶּ֔גֶב וּבֵ֥ית יוֹסֵ֛ף יַעַמְד֥וּ עַל־ גְּבוּלָ֖ם מִצָּפֽוֹן׃

passages.text: When you have mapped out the seven portions of land and brought it to me, I will cast lots for you here in the presence of the LORD our God.
passages.sermon:
Joshua spoke to the Israelites.
Joshua was their leader.
Joshua gave them instructions.
He said, “You must map the land.
Divide the land into seven portions.
Write down the divisions.
Bring the record to me here.
I will cast lots for you.
I will do this here.
I will do it before the LORD our God.”
passages.original: וְאַתֶּ֞ם תִּכְתְּב֤וּ אֶת־ הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ שִׁבְעָ֣ה חֲלָקִ֔ים וַֽהֲבֵאתֶ֥ם אֵלַ֖י הֵ֑נָּה וְיָרִ֨יתִי לָכֶ֤ם גּוֹרָל֙ פֹּ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: The Levites, however, have no portion among you, because their inheritance is the priesthood of the LORD. And Gad, Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh have already received the inheritance that Moses the servant of the LORD gave them beyond the Jordan to the east.”
passages.sermon:
The Levites are a tribe of Israel.
The Levites do not receive a portion of land among the other tribes.
The Levites’ inheritance is the priesthood of the LORD.
Gad is a tribe of Israel.
Reuben is a tribe of Israel.
Half the tribe of Manasseh is part of Israel.
Gad, Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh have already received their inheritance.
Moses, the servant of the LORD, gave them their inheritance.
Their inheritance is land beyond the Jordan River, to the east.
passages.original: כִּ֠י אֵֽין־ חֵ֤לֶק לַלְוִיִּם֙ בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֔ם כִּֽי־ כְהֻנַּ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה נַחֲלָת֑וֹ וְגָ֡ד וּרְאוּבֵ֡ן וַחֲצִי֩ שֵׁ֨בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּׁ֜ה לָקְח֣וּ נַחֲלָתָ֗ם מֵעֵ֤בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּן֙ מִזְרָ֔חָה אֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן לָהֶ֔ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֥בֶד יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: As the men got up to go out, Joshua commanded them to map out the land, saying, “Go and survey the land, map it out, and return to me. Then I will cast lots for you here in Shiloh in the presence of the LORD.”
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel at this time.
Joshua spoke to the men who were about to leave.
He gave them a command.
He told them to map out the land.
He said, “Go through the land.
Survey the land.
Write down what you find.
Return to me when you finish.
I will cast lots for you here in Shiloh.
I will do this in the presence of the LORD.”
passages.original: וַיָּקֻ֥מוּ הָאֲנָשִׁ֖ים וַיֵּלֵ֑כוּ וַיְצַ֣ו יְהוֹשֻׁ֡עַ אֶת־ הַהֹלְכִים֩ לִכְתֹּ֨ב אֶת־ הָאָ֜רֶץ לֵאמֹ֗ר לְ֠כוּ וְהִתְהַלְּכ֨וּ בָאָ֜רֶץ וְכִתְב֤וּ אוֹתָהּ֙ וְשׁ֣וּבוּ אֵלַ֔י וּ֠פֹה אַשְׁלִ֨יךְ לָכֶ֥ם גּוֹרָ֛ל לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בְּשִׁלֹֽה׃

passages.text: So the men departed and went throughout the land, mapping it city by city into seven portions. Then they returned with the document to Joshua at the camp in Shiloh.
passages.sermon:
The men left and traveled through the land.
They mapped the land city by city.
They divided the land into seven portions.
They wrote this information in a document.
They returned to Joshua at the camp in Shiloh.
passages.original: וַיֵּלְכ֤וּ הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ וַיַּעַבְר֣וּ בָאָ֔רֶץ וַיִּכְתְּב֧וּהָ לֶֽעָרִ֛ים לְשִׁבְעָ֥ה חֲלָקִ֖ים עַל־ סֵ֑פֶר וַיָּבֹ֧אוּ אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶל־ הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה שִׁלֹֽה׃

passages.text: And Joshua cast lots for them in the presence of the LORD at Shiloh, where he distributed the land to the Israelites according to their divisions.
passages.sermon:
Joshua was the leader of Israel.
\r\nHe stood at Shiloh.
\r\nThe LORD was present.
\r\nJoshua cast lots for the people.
\r\nHe did this in front of the LORD.
\r\nJoshua divided the land.
\r\nHe gave the land to the Israelites.
\r\nHe gave each group their portion.
passages.original: וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ֩ לָהֶ֨ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֧עַ גּוֹרָ֛ל בְּשִׁלֹ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיְחַלֶּק־ שָׁ֨ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֧עַ אֶת־ הָאָ֛רֶץ לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כְּמַחְלְקֹתָֽם׃פ

passages.text: The first lot came up for the clans of the tribe of Benjamin. Their allotted territory lay between the tribes of Judah and Joseph: On the north side their border began at the Jordan, went up past the northern slope of Jericho, headed west through the hill country, and came out at the wilderness of Beth-aven.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Benjamin had several clans.
Joshua cast lots for the land.
The first lot came up for the tribe of Benjamin.
Benjamin’s territory was between the tribe of Judah and the tribe of Joseph.
The northern border of Benjamin’s land began at the Jordan River.
The border went up past the northern slope of Jericho.
The border continued west through the hill country.
The border ended at the wilderness of Beth-aven.
passages.original: וַיַּ֗עַל גּוֹרַ֛ל מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־ בִנְיָמִ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם וַיֵּצֵא֙ גְּב֣וּל גּֽוֹרָלָ֔ם בֵּ֚ין בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה וּבֵ֖ין בְּנֵ֥י יוֹסֵֽף׃ וַיְהִ֨י לָהֶ֧ם הַגְּב֛וּל לִפְאַ֥ת צָפ֖וֹנָה מִן־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְעָלָ֣ה הַגְּבוּל֩ אֶל־ כֶּ֨תֶף יְרִיח֜וֹ מִצָּפ֗וֹן וְעָלָ֤ה בָהָר֙ יָ֔מָּה וְהָיָה תֹּֽצְאֹתָ֔יו מִדְבַּ֖רָה בֵּ֥ית אָֽוֶן׃

passages.text: From there the border crossed over to the southern slope of Luz (that is, Bethel) and went down to Ataroth-addar on the hill south of Lower Beth-horon.
passages.sermon:
The border of the land for the tribe of Benjamin continued from its previous point.
It crossed over to the southern slope of Luz.
Luz is also called Bethel.
From there, the border went down to Ataroth-addar.
Ataroth-addar is on a hill.
This hill is south of Lower Beth-horon.
passages.original: וְעָבַר֩ מִשָּׁ֨ם הַגְּב֜וּל ל֗וּזָה אֶל־ כֶּ֤תֶף ל֙וּזָה֙ נֶ֔גְבָּה הִ֖יא בֵּֽית־ אֵ֑ל וְיָרַ֤ד הַגְּבוּל֙ עַטְר֣וֹת אַדָּ֔ר עַל־ הָהָ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֛ר מִנֶּ֥גֶב לְבֵית־ חֹר֖וֹן תַּחְתּֽוֹן׃

passages.text: On the west side the border curved southward from the hill facing Beth-horon on the south and came out at Kiriath-baal (that is, Kiriath-jearim), a city of the sons of Judah. This was the western side.
passages.sermon:
The border marked the western side of the land for the tribe of Benjamin.
The border curved southward.
It started from the hill that faces Beth-horon on the south.
The border ended at Kiriath-baal.
Kiriath-baal is also called Kiriath-jearim.
Kiriath-jearim is a city of the sons of Judah.
This was the western border.
passages.original: וְתָאַ֣ר הַגְּבוּל֩ וְנָסַ֨ב לִפְאַת־ יָ֜ם נֶ֗גְבָּה מִן־ הָהָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י בֵית־ חֹרוֹן֮ נֶגְבָּה֒ וְהָיָה תֹֽצְאֹתָ֗יו אֶל־ קִרְיַת־ בַּ֙עַל֙ הִ֚יא קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֔ים עִ֖יר בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה זֹ֖את פְּאַת־ יָֽם׃

passages.text: On the south side the border began at the outskirts of Kiriath-jearim and extended westward to the spring at the Waters of Nephtoah.
passages.sermon:
The border marked the southern side of the territory of the tribe of Judah.
The border started at the edge of Kiriath-jearim.
Kiriath-jearim was a city in the land of Judah.
The border went west from Kiriath-jearim.
The border reached the spring called the Waters of Nephtoah.
passages.original: וּפְאַת־ נֶ֕גְבָּה מִקְצֵ֖ה קִרְיַ֣ת יְעָרִ֑ים וְיָצָ֤א הַגְּבוּל֙ יָ֔מָּה וְיָצָ֕א אֶל־ מַעְיַ֖ן מֵ֥י נֶפְתּֽוֹחַ׃

passages.text: Then it went down to the foot of the hill that faces the Valley of Hinnom at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim and ran down the Valley of Hinnom toward the southern slope of the Jebusites and downward to En-rogel.
passages.sermon:
The border went down to the foot of the hill.
This hill faces the Valley of Hinnom.
The Valley of Hinnom is at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim.
The border went down the Valley of Hinnom.
It went toward the southern slope of the Jebusites.
The border went down to En-rogel.
passages.original: וְיָרַ֨ד הַגְּב֜וּל אֶל־ קְצֵ֣ה הָהָ֗ר אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ פְּנֵי֙ גֵּ֣י בֶן־ הִנֹּ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֛ר בְּעֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִ֖ים צָפ֑וֹנָה וְיָרַד֩ גֵּ֨י הִנֹּ֜ם אֶל־ כֶּ֤תֶף הַיְבוּסִי֙ נֶ֔גְבָּה וְיָרַ֖ד עֵ֥ין רֹגֵֽל׃

passages.text: From there it curved northward and proceeded to En-shemesh and on to Geliloth facing the Ascent of Adummim, and continued down to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.
passages.sermon:
This passage describes the border of the land given to the tribe of Benjamin.
The border turned north from its previous point.
It went to En-shemesh.
It continued to Geliloth.
Geliloth is opposite the Ascent of Adummim.
The border went down to the Stone of Bohan.
Bohan was the son of Reuben.
passages.original: וְתָאַ֣ר מִצָּפ֗וֹן וְיָצָא֙ עֵ֣ין שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ וְיָצָא֙ אֶל־ גְּלִיל֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ נֹ֖כַח מַעֲלֵ֣ה אֲדֻמִּ֑ים וְיָרַ֕ד אֶ֥בֶן בֹּ֖הַן בֶּן־ רְאוּבֵֽן׃

passages.text: Then it went on to the northern slope of Beth-arabah and went down into the valley.
passages.sermon: The border continued.\r\nIt went to the northern slope of Beth-arabah.\r\nIt went down into the valley.
passages.original: וְעָבַ֛ר אֶל־ כֶּ֥תֶף מוּל־ הָֽעֲרָבָ֖ה צָפ֑וֹנָה וְיָרַ֖ד הָעֲרָבָֽתָה׃

passages.text: The border continued to the northern slope of Beth-hoglah and came out at the northern bay of the Salt Sea, at the mouth of the Jordan. This was the southern border.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Benjamin received land as their inheritance.
This land had borders.
The border went to the northern slope of Beth-hoglah.
The border reached the northern bay of the Salt Sea.
The border ended at the mouth of the Jordan River.
This border marked the southern edge of Benjamin’s land.
passages.original: וְעָבַ֨ר הַגְּב֜וּל אֶל־ כֶּ֣תֶף בֵּית־ חָגְלָה֮ צָפוֹנָה֒ וְהָיָה תֹּצְאוֹתָיו הַגְּב֗וּל אֶל־ לְשׁ֤וֹן יָם־ הַמֶּ֙לַח֙ צָפ֔וֹנָה אֶל־ קְצֵ֥ה הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן נֶ֑גְבָּה זֶ֖ה גְּב֥וּל נֶֽגֶב׃

passages.text: On the east side the border was the Jordan. These were the borders around the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Benjamin.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Benjamin received land as their inheritance.
The families of Benjamin owned this land.
The Jordan River marked the border on the east side.
These borders surrounded the inheritance of Benjamin’s families.
passages.original: וְהַיַּרְדֵּ֥ן יִגְבֹּל־ אֹת֖וֹ לִפְאַת־ קֵ֑דְמָה זֹ֡את נַחֲלַת֩ בְּנֵ֨י בִנְיָמִ֧ן לִגְבֽוּלֹתֶ֛יהָ סָבִ֖יב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: These were the cities of the clans of the tribe of Benjamin: Jericho, Beth-hoglah, Emek-keziz, Beth-arabah, Zemaraim, Bethel, Avvim, Parah, Ophrah, Chephar-ammoni, Ophni, and Geba—twelve cities, along with their villages.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Benjamin had several clans.
These clans received cities as their inheritance.
The cities were Jericho, Beth-hoglah, and Emek-keziz.
They also received Beth-arabah, Zemaraim, and Bethel.
The inheritance included Avvim, Parah, and Ophrah.
It also included Chephar-ammoni, Ophni, and Geba.
There were twelve cities in total.
These cities came with their villages.
passages.original: וְהָי֣וּ הֶֽעָרִ֗ים לְמַטֵּ֛ה בְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֽוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם יְרִיח֥וֹ וּבֵית־ חָגְלָ֖ה וְעֵ֥מֶק קְצִֽיץ׃ וּבֵ֧ית הָֽעֲרָבָ֛ה וּצְמָרַ֖יִם וּבֵֽית־ אֵֽל׃ וְהָעַוִּ֥ים וְהַפָּרָ֖ה וְעָפְרָֽה׃ וּכְפַ֧ר הָעַמֹּנִי וְהָֽעָפְנִ֖י וָגָ֑בַע עָרִ֥ים שְׁתֵּים־ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: Gibeon, Ramah, Beeroth, Mizpeh, Chephirah, Mozah, Rekem, Irpeel, Taralah, Zelah, Haeleph, Jebus (that is, Jerusalem), Gibeah, and Kiriath-jearim —fourteen cities, along with their villages. This was the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Benjamin.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Benjamin received an inheritance.
This inheritance was for the families of Benjamin.
The inheritance included cities and their villages.
The cities were Gibeon, Ramah, and Beeroth.
The cities also included Mizpeh, Chephirah, and Mozah.
Rekem, Irpeel, and Taralah were part of the inheritance.
Zelah and Haeleph were included.
Jebus is Jerusalem.
Gibeah and Kiriath-jearim were also included.
There were fourteen cities in total.
Each city had its villages.
These cities and villages were the inheritance of the families of Benjamin.
passages.original: גִּבְע֥וֹן וְהָֽרָמָ֖ה וּבְאֵרֽוֹת׃ וְהַמִּצְפֶּ֥ה וְהַכְּפִירָ֖ה וְהַמֹּצָֽה׃ וְרֶ֥קֶם וְיִרְפְּאֵ֖ל וְתַרְאֲלָֽה׃ וְצֵלַ֡ע הָאֶ֜לֶף וְהַיְבוּסִ֨י הִ֤יא יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ גִּבְעַ֣ת קִרְיַ֔ת עָרִ֥ים אַרְבַּֽע־ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה וְחַצְרֵיהֶ֑ן זֹ֛את נַֽחֲלַ֥ת בְּנֵֽי־ בִנְיָמִ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃פ
